title: Green's Theorem on an Annular Doubly-Connected Region
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For the vortex field with curl = 0 in the annulus 1 <= x^2 + y^2 <= 4, show that the circulation around outer boundary C_2 equals circulation around inner boundary C_1.

steps.title: Apply Green's Theorem for Region with Hole
steps.mathExpression: \oint_{C_2} \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} - \oint_{C_1} \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = \iint_R \left( \frac{\partial N}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial M}{\partial y} \right) dA
steps.explanation: Outer boundary is counterclockwise; inner boundary is clockwise, giving subtraction.
steps.why: Formulating Green's theorem on multiply-connected domain.

steps.title: Evaluate Zero Curl Integrand
steps.explanation: Since curl is zero in the annular region, the difference of circulations vanishes.
